paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of o_pop frequency, which is scaled by 10^4 and ranges from 1 to 19 on the x-axis, marked at integer intervals. The y-axis represents accuracy, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with gridlines at 0.2 intervals. Two lines are shown: the green solid line with square markers represents "Initial Accuracy," and the blue dashed line with circular markers represents "Final Accuracy." Both lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability. The Initial Accuracy starts at approximately 0.3 at o_pop frequency 1, rises to about 0.5 at frequency 5, dips to around 0.3 at frequency 7, then fluctuates slightly before stabilizing near 0.4 at frequency 19. The Final Accuracy begins at approximately 0.6 at frequency 1, increases to around 0.8 at frequency 5, dips to about 0.7 at frequency 7, then fluctuates with a peak near 0.9 at frequency 9, before stabilizing around 0.85 at frequency 19. The Final Accuracy remains consistently higher than the Initial Accuracy across all o_pop frequencies.
